description: Complete rebuild of the design token system (tokens.css) and the core app stylesheet (app.css) to establish a new premium, handcrafted visual language for the university platform. This is the foundation that all other CSS files build upon.
steps: Completely rewrite frontend/src/styles/tokens.css with a new premium design language. Requirements: (1) New color palette - move away from the current Material Design 3 palette to a bespoke university-grade palette. Dark theme: deep ink/slate tones (not pure black), with refined blue as accent. Light theme: warm paper whites with subtle warmth. Gold accent for achievements. Teal/cyan for AI features. (2) New typography scale - use a more refined modular scale with better hierarchy. Keep IBM Plex Sans Arabic as the primary font. Improve line-heights for Arabic readability. (3) New spacing system - keep 8px base grid but refine the scale. (4) New radius system - less rounded, more architectural (4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 20px, 24px). (5) New shadow system - softer, more layered, less aggressive. (6) New motion system - keep the same easing functions but refine durations. (7) Keep all variable NAMES that are referenced elsewhere (--bg, --surface-1, --surface-2, --surface-3, --border, --border-strong, --text, --text-muted, --text-subtle, --accent, --accent-hover, --accent-soft, --accent-border, --accent-fg, --gold, --gold-soft, --gold-hover, --success, --warning, --danger, --info, --shadow-sm/md/lg/xl, --shadow-card, --shadow-card-hover, --elev-0 through --elev-5, --focus-ring, --selection-bg, --glass-bg, --glass-border, --glass-blur, --font-sans, --font-mono, all --sp-N variables, all --r-N variables, all --t-N variables, all --ease-N variables, --sidebar-w, --topbar-h, --content-max-w, --md-primary and related, --grad-hero, --grad-accent, all semantic variables). (8) The new palette should feel: warm-neutral, calm, scholarly. Dark mode: ink-blue/charcoal backgrounds with subtle purple undertones. Light mode: warm off-white/cream with gentle blue undertones. Accent: deep sapphire blue. Gold: refined amber/champagne. (9) Reduce over-engineering - remove excessive glassmorphism, AI-glow effects, and over-the-top gradient tokens that make it feel template-like.

Completely rewrite frontend/src/styles/app.css sections 1-3 (Reset & Foundation, Typography, Layout/App Shell). Key changes: (1) Remove the body::before atmospheric gradient - it is over-designed and makes the app feel template-like. Replace with a clean solid background. (2) Simplify the sidebar design - keep the navy branded sidebar but remove the inner gradient image, simplify the brand section, make nav items cleaner with less visual noise. (3) Refine the topbar - remove the gradient hairline ::after pseudo-element, simplify to a clean border. (4) Simplify .page-header - remove the gradient background, the accent rail ::before, and the decorative glow ::after. Make it a clean, elegant header with just good typography and spacing. (5) Improve content area padding for better reading rhythm.

Completely rewrite frontend/src/styles/app.css sections 4-8 (Cards, Metrics/KPI, Buttons, Inputs/Forms, Badges). Key changes: (1) Cards: Remove the decorative top accent strip ::before on every card - it is repetitive and template-like. Make cards clean with good border, subtle shadow, clean hover. Keep the translateY hover but reduce to -2px. (2) Metrics: Remove the top accent bar ::before and the corner glow ::after. Make metrics clean cards with a colored left border OR colored icon background instead. (3) Buttons: Simplify the primary button - remove the complex 3-stop gradient, inset shadows, and excessive box-shadows. Use a solid color with subtle depth. Keep the pill shape (border-radius: full). (4) Inputs: Keep the current styling largely but reduce the focus ring to 2px and make it more subtle. (5) Badges: Keep current approach, it works.

Completely rewrite frontend/src/styles/app.css sections 9-18 (Tabs, Modals, Tables, Dropdowns, Tooltips, Avatars, Empty State, Skeleton/Loading, Progress, Pagination). Key changes: (1) Modals: Remove the decorative top gradient strip ::before on modal-card. Keep the animation. (2) Tables: Remove the gradient on thead. Use a simple background color. (3) All other components: Keep the structure but ensure they use the new token values and feel cohesive. Remove any excessive gradients or glow effects.

Completely rewrite frontend/src/styles/app.css sections 19-25 (Grid Layouts, Utilities, Dashboard Welcome/Hero, Status Widget, Bottom Nav, Notifications, Landing overrides). Key changes: (1) Welcome card: Remove the decorative glow ::before and ::after. Make it a clean gradient card without the noise. (2) Bottom nav: Keep the navy branded approach but simplify - remove backdrop-filter (it causes performance issues on mobile). (3) Landing overrides in app.css: Remove duplicate landing styles that conflict with landing.css. Clean up .landing-hero-float-card positioning. (4) Ensure all responsive breakpoints are preserved.
acceptance_criteria: tokens.css contains a complete, self-consistent design token system with all variable names preserved
Dark theme feels like premium ink/charcoal - not pure black, not too blue
Light theme feels like warm scholarly paper - not stark white, not grey
app.css provides all component styles without excessive decorative pseudo-elements
Cards, metrics, modals no longer have the repetitive gradient top strips
Body does not have an atmospheric gradient pseudo-element
Page header is clean without decorative glows
All existing CSS class names are preserved (no renaming that would break components)
Buttons feel solid and premium without complex multi-stop gradients
The overall aesthetic is restrained, quiet, and premium - not flashy or template-like
verification: Manually verify CSS syntax: check all files for balanced braces, valid selectors, no syntax errors
Verify all CSS custom property references in app.css have corresponding definitions in tokens.css
Verify no class names were removed that are referenced in TSX component files
findings: All 135 critical CSS variables preserved. Added md-surface, md-on-surface, md-on-surface-variant, md-outline-variant, md-surface-container-* tokens back that were needed by redesign-lecture.css and redesign-matrix.css. All variable references across all CSS files validated with automated script. CSS has 576 balanced brace pairs. tokens.css at 337 lines, app.css at 3610 lines. No build/test commands available due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - validation was CSS syntax and variable reference checking only.
